segments.name: AI-ECG solutions
segments.description: Develops and commercializes ECG management software and AI-ECG solutions for cardiovascular diagnostic testing.
segments.evidence: Management and the CODM view the Company's operations and manage its business in one operating segment, which is the business of identifying, developing and commercializing products and AI-ECG solutions in the cardiovascular diagnostic technology field.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay installation fees, software-as-a-service usage fees, and fees for AI-ECG algorithms offered through the platform's marketplace.
revenueModel.evidence: We expect to generate revenue from installation fees, software-as-a-service ("SaaS") usage fees, and fees associated with AI-ECG algorithms made available through the platform's AI-ECG marketplace, including third-party algorithms.
